scope: provisional Phase 7W executable subset only; not canonical Arcane grammar
instructions: Before enabling these fixtures, map each case to syntax actually supported by the checked-out parser. Cases marked conditional must be skipped or converted to deliberate-rejection tests if the feature is not implemented.

cases.note: Use a supported binary arithmetic operator and assert the exact result.
Choose operands so the conventional precedence parse and the alternative parse produce different results; derive expected behaviour from the implementation contract.
Use a non-associative example such as subtraction to distinguish left and right grouping.
Show parentheses alter grouping when the grammar supports them.
Checker and runtime must agree on valid nested calls.

cases.purpose: same malformed input is rejected consistently
cases.note: Compare error category and phase; exact wording may differ if documented.

cases.purpose: diagnostic includes real source location when available
cases.note: Never invent line or column information.
